name: romhacking
description: ROM hacking method for game translation: a guided, gated workflow from unknown target to shipped patch. Skills covering text discovery, tables, control codes, DTE/MTE, pointers, compression, archives, disc images, expansion, graphics, fonts, VWF, accented glyphs, assembly hooks, glossary, QA and patching — each explaining the subject before the procedure. Orchestrates the emulator plugins instead of duplicating them.
